epics.title: GUI shell and docking framework
epics.summary: Scaffold the dockable main window, mode controls, layout persistence, and user-facing shell for the next-generation GUI.
definition_of_done: Main window shell exists with the planned docking zones.
Mode switching and persistent layout are wired into the shell.
Theme hooks and status surfaces are in place.

epics.title: Spectrum canvas and renderer abstraction
epics.summary: Create the abstract spectrum canvas and register production and stub render backends.
definition_of_done: SpectrumCanvas abstraction exists.
PyQtGraph backend is registered as the recommended default.
Vispy remains additive as an optional backend stub.

epics.title: File I/O, session model, and N42.42 export
epics.summary: Define the session model, file readers, and N42.42 export path needed for the shell.
definition_of_done: Session model and `.ffs` persistence exist.
Planned file readers are routed through a single factory.
N42.42 export path exists with validation hooks.

epics.title: Nuclide library database
epics.summary: Build the nuclide database schema and search surfaces needed for interactive line overlay workflows.
definition_of_done: SQLite schema exists with decay-chain support.
Search surfaces can query the library efficiently.
Canvas overlays can be driven from the search result model.

epics.title: Core spectroscopy workflows (calibration, fitting, ID, activity)
epics.summary: Deliver calibration, peak fitting, identification, and activity workflows with coordinated GUI surfaces.
definition_of_done: Peak and calibration shells exist in the new GUI architecture.
Selection state is shared across canvas and tables.
Activity workflows have an obvious integration path.

epics.title: Standards and QA framework
epics.summary: Establish standards modules, QA tracking, and standards-mode locking surfaces.
definition_of_done: Standards module interface exists.
QA tracking and history surfaces have storage scaffolding.
Standards locking has a dedicated architectural path.

epics.title: Unfolding workspace (GRAVEL + MAXED + RMLE + ML)
epics.summary: Provide the additive unfolding workspace and algorithm registry foundation.
definition_of_done: Unfolding workspace scaffold exists.
Algorithm registry includes additive support for all planned methods.
Method provenance is designed into the workflow.

epics.title: HAL, live acquisition, and dashboard foundation
epics.summary: Define HAL contracts early so live acquisition can be added later without GUI rewrites.
definition_of_done: Device abstractions and mock devices exist.
GUI surfaces reserve dashboard and hardware status integration points.
Session model can carry hardware provenance.

epics.title: Reporting engine and packaging
epics.summary: Scaffold reporting and packaging surfaces early enough to record provenance and later deliver native bundles.
definition_of_done: Reporting skeleton exists with a template-driven path.
Packaging and release work have explicit tracker entries.
Report provenance remains part of the design.

epics.title: Plugin/registry architecture
epics.summary: Create the shared plugin registry layer that keeps new methods additive and discoverable.
definition_of_done: Generic registry implementation exists.
Named registries exist for the planned analytical dimensions.
Built-in bootstrap path exists without locking the project to a single implementation.
